transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1954 Creekhaven Drive?
Yes, this is 1954 Creekhaven Drive. We’re safe, four people here, no water inside.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Four people total. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or medical needs here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone’s safe here.
Understood, no water inside and everyone’s safe here. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. Everyone’s safe here.
Understood, everyone’s safe here. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right. Four people, no water inside yet.
Acknowledged, four people, no water inside yet. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
